key_insight: Test-Time Baking (TTB) compresses global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP. This aims to make novel-view rendering faster while preserving high visual quality.
problem_solved: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models deliver high-quality novel views without reconstructing explicit 3D geometry, but their attention and KV-cache impose computational costs. Existing Test-Time Training layers reduce computation at the expense of quality.
method: Use cross-view attention to capture global scene information from input views.
At test time, learn to bake that information into a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP).
Use the baked scene information for efficient, high-fidelity novel-view decoding.
impact: TTB offers a route toward more efficient view synthesis without the quality compromise associated with Test-Time Training layers. The provided abstract is incomplete and includes no quantitative results.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: input views → cross-view attention → scene information baked into an MLP → novel views.

paper_title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
paper_authors: Chin-Yang Lin, Ryo Hachiuma, Jaesung Choe, Min-Hung Chen, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang
